tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Searches Domus Aedes' own portfolio of properties to buy, rent long-term, or stay in (short-term) across Spain and Morocco. Returns up to six best matches for the criteria, whether more matches exist, and refinement suggestions (budget, area, bedrooms, features) that narrow the search. Budgets are E

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Returns full details for one Domus Aedes property by reference: description, all key facts, up to 12 photos, approximate location, public listing page, and — for stays with dates — live availability and total.

tools.name: request_property_details
tools.description: Sends the person's contact details and message about a property (or a general brief) to a Domus Aedes advisor, who replies by email or WhatsApp. Requires name, email and a message; phone is optional.
